origin.description: Regress the log periodogram on the frequency to estimate d.

arguments.name: bandw.exp
arguments.text: The number of frequencies is trunc(n to this power). In Python the argument is bandw_exp.

origin.details: The periodogram uses the biased autocovariance, divided by n. Frequencies with a non-positive periodogram are dropped. The returned d is minus the regression slope.
origin.value: d, the asymptotic standard error, and the regression standard error.
origin.example: g <- fdGPH(sin(1:40) + 0.3 * cos((1:40) / 3)); cat(g$d, g$sd.as, g$sd.reg, "\n")
